title: goulardia canina
intro: Goulardia canina, commonly known as Ginkgo biloba, is an ancient plant species native to China. It is renowned for its numerous health benefits, including improving memory and cognitive function, reducing the risk of age-related diseases, and acting as an antioxidant to combat cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Ginkgo biloba include anti-inflammatory properties, vasodilation, and the inhibition of platelet aggregation, which can help prevent blood clots. The bioactive constituents of Ginkgo biloba include flavonoids, terpenoids, and bilobalide, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its various health benefits.
